request.state:
Icelandic original: „Þetta er bær sem ég hef miklar fjölskildu teyngíngar og hef ferðast þángað öll sumar frá því að ég var lítill strákur og búinn að leika mér í hrauninu og fara í bíltúra um aðaldalinn og vera með fólkinnu mínu“
English gloss: “This is a village where I have many cherished memories and I have traveled there every summer since I was a little boy, playing for myself in the lava field and driving in a car along the mountain road and being with my people.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
